raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 성인 대상 동네 건축 사진전과 공간 해설 행사를 안내해줘. 처음 오는 주민도 편하게 참여할 수 있고 건축과 빛을 관찰하는 즐거움이 느껴지게 해줘. 생활문화공간과 커뮤니티 디지털 화면에 쓰는 16:9 가로형으로 서로 다른 스타일 다섯 장을 만들어줘. 스타일은 맡길게. 건축 공간의 빛과 형태를 보는 사진전, 함께 듣는 공간 이야기가 하나의 행사로 연결되어 보이고 일정·장소·입장·신청·방문 안내가 읽혀야 해. 특정 실존 건물이나 기관의 홍보물로 보이지 않도록 해줘. 단색 또는 유사 단색 배경에 큰 고딕 제목·날짜·안내문을 올리고 사진을 작은 칸이나 아래 띠로 붙이는 전체 구성은 제외해줘. 색을 나누거나 얇은 질감·그라데이션을 더하거나 글꼴만 바꾸어 같은 템플릿을 유지하지 말고, 이미지·시점·크롭·공간·글자·정보의 관계부터 서로 다른 전체 스타일로 설계해줘. 아래 문구만 각각 한 번씩 넣어줘.

typography.location: upper-right offer lines and all schedule/visit text

space.location: central lit wall, left purple planes and narrow right pier

evidence.location: central light wedge extending over the floor and right opening
evidence.observation: The light passage connects wall and floor within an intelligible room and remains a major visual construction at use scale.

content_form.location: central illuminated wall and light spreading onto floor

The descriptor below the title makes the exhibition/talk event explicit; physical photographs and discussion are not depicted, leaving the event activity more dependent on copy.

hierarchy.location: central title and opposing dark practical areas
hierarchy.observation: The large central title is unambiguous; date and English heading sit on the left, participation occupies a narrow right column, and venue/welcome occupy distinct floor corners. Contrast and size maintain a coherent title-first hierarchy.

typography.location: central serif Hangul and practical sans blocks
typography.observation: The sculptural serif title has clear glyph forms and a balanced two-line shape; supporting sans type stays crisp. The right participation blocks wrap after a middle dot without changing words or punctuation.

typography.location: white on purple and dark on pale floor

space.location: central wall width, right pier and diagonal floor light

image_material.location: vertical reveals and broad shadow/light shapes
image_material.observation: Smooth simplified surfaces, strong edge transitions and controlled tonal depth form a consistent graphic architecture. There is no requirement for literal photography; this abstraction is sufficiently constructed to communicate walls, openings and light.

emotion_control.location: purple/coral contrast and pale light triangle
emotion_control.observation: The saturated room creates a lively invitation while the ordered information and warm illuminated center keep it suitable for adults. The friendly visit lines temper the dramatic architecture without muting the chosen expressive style.

ai_slop.location: whole plane construction and copy
ai_slop.observation: There are no incidental pseudo-labels, gratuitous ornament clusters or broken printed characters. The large polygons represent architecture/light rather than unrelated decoration; the room and title relationship stays coherent.

residuals: The architecture/light idea is direct, while photographic exhibition and shared discussion remain verbal rather than visibly enacted.

hierarchy.location: large lower-center title under the gallery scene
hierarchy.observation: The near-floor title is the dominant type anchor, with event descriptor above and English below; upper corner information remains secondary. The scene and framed entry view have a clear relationship to the title.

hierarchy.location: upper left/right information and lower-left visit lines
hierarchy.observation: Practical groups are separated by function and remain readable without competing with the title.

typography.location: main title and tracked OPEN HOUSE

typography.location: upper-left venue/admission and lower-left welcome lines
typography.observation: Small Korean remains legible against pale planes; welcome copy fits the floor without touching the left foreground figure or main title.

space.location: foreground shoulders, photo wall and broad near floor
space.observation: The large cropped visitors form intentional framing rather than accidental edge cuts. Middle-distance viewing/talking is balanced above a generous floor area for the title; the practical copy uses distinct light-wall and floor gaps.

image_material.location: visitors, benches, architectural photographs and lit floor
image_material.observation: Illustrated figures have coherent body poses and readable interactions; benches and picture perspectives support the room. Floor reflections and window shadows agree with the light direction. Local plant/figure detail is somewhat standardized but controlled rather than visibly broken.

emotion_control.location: standing visitors and seated talk group under warm window light
emotion_control.observation: Shared looking and a small informal seated discussion produce a hospitable adult community atmosphere. Light, plants and reassurance strengthen the invitation without turning it into a branded institutional promotion.

ai_slop.location: people, wall photographs and surrounding plants
ai_slop.observation: Repeated plants and photo rectangles have plausible gallery roles; there are no floating pseudo-text marks, extra logos or gross anatomy failures. The highly staged clean interior and conventional friendly figures are generic residuals, but the scene is coherent.

residuals: The staged pristine gallery, repeated plants and conventional visitor poses are familiar rather than unusually specific; this limits the work to strong professional refinement, not score 5.

procedure.method: Fresh independent review with no spawn, resume, fork or peer/producer-record inspection. Read the pinned packet, case, rubric, rules and compact method; read all five listed native-evidence manifests before poster opens, without following their unlisted embedded paths. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are empty, so there were no source opens or protected manifests to read. Byte/hash/PNG-header checks were metadata verification only, not claimed visual opens. Actually opened and inspected the fifteen exact poster assets with tools.view_image(detail=original), emitting each returned image for visual inspection, sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same view order. All fifteen were completed before the first copy-reading/transcription, judgment or score. First readings were taken from those displayed pinned views after the complete sequence; usage720 readability and thumbnail hierarchy were assessed from their actual displayed assets. No ambiguity required a revisit. Each native was verified as RGB PNG 1672x941; 16:9 acceptance uses the pinned single-edge height-rounding difference of 0.5 pixel. Usage views are 720x405 and thumbnails 320x180, with the required aspect and reduction sizes. No helper exit or filename was treated as proof of viewing and no runtime session/tool-event ID is claimed.

emotion_control.location: dark left opening, oversized structural crops and empty rooms

image_material.location: people, framed photographs, benches and foliage
image_material.observation: The painterly illustration combines convincing room depth, repeated architectural photo subjects, understandable seating and softly modeled adult figures. Benches, plants and sunlight belong to the same room treatment; small faces/hands are simplified and not exceptional in local refinement.

emotion_control.location: arrival framing and seated adult conversation
emotion_control.observation: The warm gallery, relaxed seated exchange and people quietly viewing images show participation as ordinary and manageable. The reassurance matches the pictured activity and supports a first-time resident without a loud promotional tone.

ai_slop.location: photo row, plant/bench details and discussion group
ai_slop.observation: Recurring plants and photo subjects have understandable room/exhibition roles, and the people form coherent viewing or conversation groups. No spurious symbols, pseudo-text or watermark appear. Repeated sunlit-room subjects and schematic small human details keep the finish below exceptional specificity.

evidence.location: whole single-room composition
evidence.observation: A deep full-bleed photographic room anchors a low-left two-line serif title and high-right wall information, with reassurance on the floor. evidence.location: central pillar and paired image planes
evidence.observation: The vertical three-line sans-serif title divides two differently cropped room studies; information is distributed around that hinge, and a strong oblique beam dominates the right. This changes image/type roles and reading organization from M1 single-room corner title, not merely color or texture.

evidence.location: architectural section, left column and roof-side name
evidence.observation: An illustrated cutaway and stair boundary expose exhibition viewing and conversation, while facts occupy the left void and the smaller name sits above the roof. Its section viewpoint, diagrammatic edges and scene-led hierarchy differ from M5 eye-level visitor frame and lower-floor title, even though both repeat a four-photo gallery motif.

evidence.location: central light wedge and side piers
evidence.observation: A saturated graphic room makes a broad central serif title part of the illuminated plane, with terms in the right pier and schedule/venue separated on the left. The plane/light construction and information distribution differ from the photographic diptych, section diagram and immersive gallery; color alone is not the basis of the difference.

evidence.location: foreground people, gallery activity and lower-floor title
evidence.observation: Close cropped visitors create an eye-level arrival frame around a viewing wall and seated exchange. The large one-line name occupies the foreground floor below the activity, with practical groups above; this changes crop, viewpoint, occupied/empty space and headline role from M3 as well as M1/M2/M4.

evidence.location: whole set relationship
evidence.observation: The five layouts materially change viewpoint/crop and image/type/information relationships. Nevertheless all put much of the copy on architectural surfaces, M1/M2 share polished empty sunlit interiors, and M3/M5 share the photo-row plus social-gallery subject. The set is strongly differentiated rather than exceptionally broad in its visual vocabulary.

residuals: Diversity is 4, not 5: the photographic pair and the illustrated gallery pair retain family resemblance in image subjects and architectural-surface copy placement.
M2 emotion_control is 3 because the monumental empty fragments feel formal and provide little visible neighborhood participation context.
M4 content_form is 3 because its general room/light metaphor assigns the exhibition and space-talk relationship to the subtitle instead of distinct visual activity.
